description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab, in collaboration with Rotaract Club of JES College – Parivartan, Rotaract Club of Mumbai JVLR Connect and Sarva Seva Sangh, conducted a Go Green – Tree Plantation Drive on 2nd October 2026.
The initiative focused on sustainability and giving a new lease of life to fruit plants that were no longer required by residents of Oberoi Splendor. Around 25 plants were collected, along with a few additional plants purchased from a nursery. The activity was funded by Ms. Mukta.
With the help of a lorry, the plants were transported to Gyan Ashram – Sarva Seva Sangh, where 16 Rotaractors and 5 RCMSEP members, along with the Fathers of Sarva Seva Sangh, came together to plant them.
It was truly a meaningful Sustainability Drive, turning unused plants into a greener future.
